summary: Faster W4A16 decode on NVFP4-CSF checkpoints: compressed expert scales are read inside the MoE kernel
compatibility: No user action required. Calls above the stage-read token limit keep the per-layer scale expansion.
details: W4A16 MoE kernels rebuild each pipeline stage's E4M3 expert scales in shared memory from stage-readable NVFP4-CSF storage instead of expanding all routed experts' scales into scratch before the MoE.
GLM-5.3-Flash stored QAD CSF checkpoint, TP2/DCP2 MTP3 on 2x RTX PRO 6000 Max-Q: decode C8 +10% and C1 +1.6% per step versus the per-layer expansion; prefill and needle-checksum exactness unchanged.
